title: Quality Telemetry Event
description: Local-first quality telemetry event emitted from quality engine output and scorecard reports. The schema intentionally captures only run metadata, status, timing, model/task/profile context, and a hash of redacted evidence.

event_id.description: Unique event identifier for this telemetry event. UUIDs are recommended; deterministic IDs are acceptable for reproducible collector dry runs.

timestamp.description: Event timestamp in ISO 8601 date-time format. Prefer the source run timestamp when present.

gate_id.description: Quality gate identifier. Use aggregate pseudo-gates such as quality-engine or quality-scorecard-report for run/report summary events.

duration_ms.description: Gate or report duration in milliseconds. Use 0 when the source report does not contain timing.

model_id.description: Model identifier if known; otherwise use unknown. Do not include prompts or raw model output.

task_type.description: Task type or risk category if known; otherwise use any or unknown.

profile.description: Quality engine/model profile such as lean, standard, heavy, or unknown.

evidence_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of redacted evidence used for deduplication and audit without storing raw logs or private content.
